title: Execution with refreshed local variables
statement: Let $xs$ be a list of local indices, let $s$ be a statement, and let $l$ be a list of integers. If $s$ has an execution from the state with frame $l$ and memory $\mu$, of cost at most $T_1$, ending in a state satisfying $R$, and every such final state with locals $\mathrm{loc}'$ and memory $\mu'$ gives $Q$ in the state with frame obtained by refreshing the locals in $l$ at indices $xs$ from $\mathrm{loc}'$ and memory $\mu'$, then $s$ has an execution from the original state with cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$, provided every local assigned by $s$ occurs in $xs$ and $T_1\le T$.
